1. Entry is restricted to pass holders only.)  2. We provide Telephone Dialing facility for outgoing calls which is chargeable (Rs.5/- per minute).
3. Wi-Fi facility can be availed on one device, login to HHS -Wi-Fi. (6050). HHK Patient 10 iL,
4. Children below 12 yrs. are restricted due to risk of infection.
5. Do not keep any valuables in the vehicle / room unattended. Smoking & Alcohol Consumption is  strictly prohibited, (Hospital is not responsible for any loss or damage of valuables)
6. Check in and Check Out time is 11am to 11am.

7. During the patients stay in hospital room or ICU It is mandatory for one relative to accompany the patient  for 24hours. (One 24 hours attendant pass will be Issued at the time of admission. Visitors can  utilize the 24 hours attendant pass on a rotation basis to meet the patient between 8:00 am  to 8:00 pm for rooms b ICU 5,00 pm to 7.00 pm)

8. An amount of Rs. 500/- will be applicable as additional charges (Non Refundable) for ward key / ICU  key and passes, if the key/Passes is not returned at the time of discharge / misplaced during  the hospital stay.

9. Outside Food / Medicines / Linen / Water/ Crockery / Gifts / Flowers / Sweets / Toys / pillow/ bed  sheet for patient/relative are strictly not permitted to be brought inside the hospital premises.  Outside/Home food for relative is not permitted. Room service is available for the relative which  is on chargeable basis.

10. Valet parking services are available 24x7 which is chargeable on the following basis: Per Hour - Rs.50/-  24 Hours- Rs.750/- (During the 24hrs parking valet cannot be removed within 24 hrs, otherwise  charges will be applicable as per hourly basis.)
11. Parking is at owner's risk & kindly ensure that all occupants (including pets) are alighted before handover  of vehicle for Valet parking.
12. Security checks would be done at regular intervals to ensure that there are no extra visitors. This is done  keeping in mind the wellbeing of the patient.

3. Facilities of meal for the relative of ICU patients only, is provided on Ground floor cafeteria  on chargeable basis.
